title.subtitle: Helix Institute — Sector B
intro.1:
Helix Institute — Sector B

Closed for six years.
Officially, for budget reasons.
intro.2:
The site is sealed off.
Only one position remains: night watchman.

You start tonight.
intro.3: Your predecessor never handed in his badge.
intro.4:
12:13 a.m.

The power just went out.
end.lost: The night watchman position is open again.
objective.start: Restore the power: find a fuse and the generator code.
objective.repair: Repair the generator in the maintenance room.
locker.leave: You step out of the locker.
panel.no_fuse: A fuse has blown. You need a spare one.
panel.no_code: The generator asks for a three-digit code.
panel.restored: The generator starts. The power comes back, the exit is unlocked!
exit.locked: Locked. Without power, the door won't open.
exit.open: 5:58 a.m. You hand in your badge.
code_note.title: Note from Daniel Morel
code_note.text:
If you're reading this, the power is out and the B doors are open.
There's a spare fuse in the storeroom, to the north-east.
It's locked: I left my keycard in the maintenance room, to the south-west.
Generator code: 4 7 _. The last digit is in my journal, south-east wing.
Don't run unless you have to. It hears.
Hand in your badge on time.
— D. M.
door.locked: Locked. The reader wants a keycard.
door.open: Beep. Keycard accepted, the door opens.
pause.title: PAUSE
panel.code_incomplete: 4, 7... The last digit of the code is missing.
objective.find_code_end: Find the last digit of the code.
